examples/origin_neg_capture.sober:8:32: error: the shared cache policy 'Fresh' meets the credential source 'std/http/server.Authorization' in one route — a response that depends on Authorization / Cookie must not be stored by a shared cache — it would be served to other users (language.md 12 節「出所の依存」); use server.Private / server.NoStore for this route, or move the credential read out of it (Analyzer)
